deck_context.source_summary: Class 26, Week 6, September 21 2026. AEM Sites traditional, local Author SDK. New calendar: query/index diagnosis belongs to Class27. English slide text; Spanish study guide.
deck_context.core_claim: Define the content selection before writing a query: path, node type, tag, order and bounded results.
canonical_facts: Fixture path /content/wknd/us/en/training-search. Archetype users substitute their real site root.
Query returns cq:Page nodes. Tags and titles are under jcr:content.
Exact property matching of cq:tags is intentional; it does not expand descendants or moved-tag aliases.
QueryBuilder evaluates predicates and typically produces XPath; JCR-SQL2 is a separate equivalent expression, not its output.
Use p.limit=2, p.offset=0 or 2, p.guessTotal=true. Order by title; fixture titles are unique and content stays unchanged.
Two hiking matches: 01 Forest trail, 02 River trail. A cycling page, untagged page and hiking page outside the root are excluded.
Fulltext is an optional additional filter and depends on indexed content.
No custom index, servlet, service user, assignment or deliverable in this lesson.

key_points: Tags classify content through stable IDs.
Path, type and properties define the selection.
Order, limit and offset define a result window.
Exact tag matching and full-text solve different needs.
Results depend on repository state and read permissions.
